get.description: Up to three example requests the Book can answer, each with its intent. Requesting a report by one of these intents needs no AI.

schema.description: Language of the texts, as a BCP 47 tag of one of the Bkper languages, such as `pt` or `pt-BR`.

parameters.description: Language of the texts, as a BCP 47 tag of one of the Bkper languages, such as `pt` or `pt-BR`.
parameters.name: language

403.description: No permission to read the Book (`forbidden`)

post.summary: Build a report of a Book
post.description: Builds a financial report from a request in any language (`prompt`) or from an `intent`. Numbers are computed from the Book balances; the Book is never changed.

403.description: No permission to read the Book (`forbidden`)

422.description: Not a report of this Book (`not_a_report`, with suggestions), a period that has not started (`future_period`) or an unknown root (`unknown_root`)

code.description: invalid_request, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, book_not_found, not_a_report, future_period, unknown_root, ai_allowance_exhausted, upstream_error or internal_error.

message.example: Book not found, or not shared with you.

ReportIntent.description: What to report: a root group id or `net-result`, a period id (`this_year`, `last_month`, `2025`, `2025-Q3`, `2025-10`, …), whether by month, an optional view and hashtags.

language.description: The Bkper language of the texts.

query.description: The Bkper query of exactly the report’s transactions and dates.

url.description: The report in the Report app.

ReportSpec.description: The report as a json-render spec of the report catalog, in `language`.

suggestions.description: With `not_a_report`: reports this Book can have.

prompt.description: The report asked for, in any language.

language.description: Language of the texts, as a BCP 47 tag of one of the Bkper languages, such as `pt` or `pt-BR`.

format.description: What to return; `spec` (the default) is a json-render spec.

ReportRequest.description: Exactly one of `prompt` (a request in any language) or `intent` (such as a suggestion’s, which needs no AI).
